chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Miskan, from Abi Basir, who said:

I asked him about one who forgot to perform one sajdah and then remembered it while he was standing. He said: He should perform it when he remembers it, so long as he has not yet bowed in ruku'. But if he has already performed ruku', then he should continue with his salat, and when he finishes, he should make it up; and there is no sahw upon him.

key_terms.انْصَرَفَ: finished and exited from the prayer
key_terms.سَهْوٌ: a compensatory ruling connected to forgetfulness in prayer
key_terms.قَائِمٌ: standing in the prayer after the place of prostration
key_terms.قَضَاهَا: he makes up the missed sajdah afterward

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he forgets one sajdah in salat and remembers after standing up?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding one who forgets a single sajdah in salat. If he remembers before ruku', he performs it immediately; if he remembers after ruku', he continues the prayer and makes up the missed sajdah after finishing, without sahw being required.
